title: $100 a month into Walmart since 1990 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Walmart since 1990.
Today that would be worth about {dca:WMT:1990-01-02} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Walmart price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Walmart, starting in 1990.
Back then, Walmart was a discount store.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:WMT:1990-01-02}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
